metadata.name: HoldPaymentDetails
metadata.description: This API is used to provide the details of the payment which is on Hold.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Account number of cardholder. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:7314145404 Condition:At least one Account identifier input parameter should be passed. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: TransactionID
request_fields.description: Transaction ID of the payment for which the details are being retrieved. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example:23654789 Condition:At least one Account identifier input parameter should be passed. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: AdminNumber
request_fields.description: Details can be obtained by admin number (Embossing Acctid) Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:12345 Condition:At least one Account identifier input parameter should be passed.

request_fields.name: CardNumber
request_fields.description: Card Number of account holder. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example:1236547896541236 Condition:At least one Account identifier input parameter should be passed. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: AccountID
request_fields.description: Account ID represents Unique Identity of Account (CoreCard Bsegment Entitity, i.e., the Account ID of program card account). Format:XXXXX Example:12345

request_fields.name: BatchSize
request_fields.description: Number of Transaction which can be view in one Batch Default Value would be 50. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XX Example:20

request_fields.name: PageIndex
request_fields.description: Number of page Default value would be 0 Valid Values:0-9 Format:XX Example:12

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: AccountNumber
children.description: Account number of cardholder. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:7314145404 Allowable Values: 19

children.name: PaymentTransactionID
children.description: Hold Payment Transaction ID Valid Values: 0- 9 Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:123372036854793826 Allowable Values: 15

children.name: HoldAmount
children.description: Amount of hold payment Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXX.XX Example:245.23

children.name: PaymentPostTime
children.description: Time and Date of Hold Payment posted.

children.name: HoldReleaseDate
children.description: Actual date when the payment hold is released. Format: MM/DD/YYYY Example:02/02/2020

children.name: PaymentHoldRuleName
children.description: This tags will indicate the rule name of the hold payment. valid values- 0-9,a-z format- xxxx dexample - ACH payment hold Allowable Values: 50

children.name: TransactionCode
children.description: A code to identify type of payment. Valid Values: A-Z 0-9 Format: xxxxxx Example:427248 = Principal Adjustment Allowable Values: 20

children.name: HoldStatus
children.description: Status of the Hold Payment. Example:0 = On-Hold 1 = Released Automatically 2 = Released Manually Allowable Values: 50

children.name: MediumRiskRule
children.description: Low Risk Rule (overrides payment hold to immediate release only if ALL of the below are met): i.Hold recommendation on payment based on account level computation = 2 business days ii.Payment does not hit any of the high risk intraday rules stated above iii.Current balance less then equal 25 % of CL at payment posting iv.	Total cumulative payment intraday less then equal 25% of CL v.No payments currently being held for 6 business days vi.Payment does not cause any credit balance Allowable Values: 50

children.name: HighRiskRule
children.description: High Risk Rules overrides payment hold to 6 business days if ANY of the following is met on the payment): i.If a payment causes credit balance of more than $1,000 on account(i.e.at the time of payment posting, payment - balance > $1000) ii.Any intraday payment RIP notification iii.Number of unique ACH funding accounts used to make payments over the last 7 days > 1 Allowable Values: 50

children.name: TotalPaymentOnHold
children.description: Total or cumulative number of payments on hold. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XX Example:2

children.name: TotalAmountOnHold
children.description: Total or cumulative amount of payments on hold. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXX.XX Example:245.23

children.name: ResponseID
children.description: This number indicates that API responded.Response ID is unique. This value will be null if no authentication information was passed.Response ID can be used for tracking. Allowable Values: 15

children.name: RevolvingPlanPaymentOnHold
children.description: This indicates the payment amount on hold for revolving plans when revolving plan capping is defined in the program. Valid Values:0-9 Example:$500.00
